d:
Celebrate the timeless bond of love and destiny with “Yeh Bandhan Toh” from the iconic Bollywood film Karan Arjun, now presented in stunning 8K video quality. This evergreen song is beautifully sung by Kumar Sanu, Udit Narayan, and Alka Yagnik, making it one of the most memorable melodies of the 90s.
Song Credits:
Song: Yeh Bandhan Toh
Movie: Karan Arjun
Singer(s): Kumar Sanu, Udit Narayan, Alka Yagnik
Music Director: Rajesh Roshan
Lyricist: Indeevar
